rules: .wpn { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.wpn .key { font: 600 9px var(--font); letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: #c9a6d9; white-space: nowrap; }
.attack .ring.emp { width: 74px; height: 74px; background: conic-gradient(#ff2bd6 var(--p, 100%), rgba(25, 230, 255, 0.25) 0); }

.attack .ring.emp b { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; background: #0a0420; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 900 16px var(--font); color: #ffc4f4; text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--m); }

.attack .ring { width: 86px; height: 86px; border-radius: 50%; padding: 6px; background: conic-gradient(var(--m) var(--p, 100%), rgba(25, 230, 255, 0.35) 0); display: grid; place-items: center; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px var(--m)); }
